The Maine knowledge test

  • 30 multiple-choice questions.
  • You need 24 correct answers to pass (80%).
  • The state also gives the test in Spanish.

Practice questions

209 practice questions for Maine: 31 about Maine rules and 178 about signs, signals and markings that are the same in every state. Free: every question, hints and read-aloud. No sign-up.

Languages

  • The 178 national questions (signs, signals, road markings) also in 中文, Tiếng Việt, Tagalog, العربية. In these languages the Maine questions show in English for now.

5 sample questions

1. In Maine, what is the youngest age to get a learner's permit?

  1. 14 years old
  2. 15 years old (correct answer)
  3. 16 years old
  4. 17 years old

Answer: B. In Maine you can get a learner's permit at 15. If you are under 18, you must also take an approved driver education course.

Maine handbook, page 1-2.

2. In Maine, may a driver with a learner's permit use a cell phone while driving?

  1. Yes, if it is hands-free
  2. No, a cell phone may not be used (correct answer)
  3. Yes, at red lights
  4. Yes, if the supervisor allows it

Answer: B. In Maine, a driver with a learner's permit may not use a cell phone while driving, not even hands-free.

Maine handbook, page 1-2.

3. In Maine, what is the top speed outside a business, residential or built-up area when no speed limit is posted?

  1. 35 mph
  2. 55 mph
  3. 65 mph
  4. 45 mph (correct answer)

Answer: D. In Maine, unless a sign says otherwise, the top speed outside business, residential and built-up areas is 45 mph.

Maine handbook, page 8-7.

4. In Maine, a driver is convicted of passing a stopped school bus with its red lights flashing. How long may the license be suspended?

  1. 7 days
  2. 1 year
  3. 30 days (correct answer)
  4. 6 months

Answer: C. In Maine, a driver convicted of passing a stopped school bus with flashing red lights may have the license suspended for 30 days.

Maine handbook, page 1-8.

5. In Maine, how many hours of practice driving must a permit holder under 21 log?

  1. 30 hours
  2. 50 hours
  3. 70 hours (correct answer)
  4. 100 hours

Answer: C. A Maine permit holder under 21 must log 70 hours of practice driving.

Maine handbook, page 1-3.
